messages.subject: Project Beacon - post-completion matters
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Post-completion update: SDRT of GBP237,500 has been submitted to HMRC; the stock transfer forms will be stamped on receipt. We've filed the director changes and registered-office change at Companies House and updated the register of members to show Beacon Bidco as sole shareholder. Closing bible to follow once the stamped transfers are back.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0815
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
